message.content: **Summary:** I researched Amazon on the web and checked the live quote ($195.25, bid/ask 195.23/195.27 as of 2024-11-06 15:05 UTC). The search results were largely low-quality "roundup" pages and the Q3 2024 press release pages were not retrievable, so I anchored my decision on Amazon's verified SEC-filed FY2023 10-K figures: total net sales of $574,785M, operating income of $36,852M, net income of $30,425M, diluted EPS of $2.90, and operating cash flow of $84,946M — a sharp improvement over FY2022 (net loss of $2,722M, operating income $12,248M), showing strong margin recovery and cash generation. On that basis I placed one buy order for 25 shares of AMZN at a limit of $195.60 (just above the market ask, so it filled at $195.60), a total of about $4,890 — within the $5,000 per-order cap, the $10,000 daily cap, and the AMZN/HD buy-only mandate, with no money moved out of the account. Note: because the Q3 2024 release wasn't accessible, my decision rests on annual FY2023 fundamentals rather than the most recent quarter.
